purpose: Define the minimal, architecture-neutral bootstrap ladder for a CYNIC node joining the organism.

principle.definition: Bootstrap is the smallest auditable path by which a heterogeneous machine becomes observable, addressable and eventually actionable without assuming the full organism is already healthy.
principle.why: The organism currently lives on one operator's material substrate; external heterogeneous setups need deterministic birth stages instead of implicit local knowledge.
principle.anti_chicken_egg_rule: A bootstrap stage may depend only on earlier stages. No stage may require the lifecycle/mempool path it is supposed to restore.

bootstrap_ladder.meaning: cynic-node executable can start on the host architecture.
node name, OS, architecture, hostname and local IPs are observable.
node can reach the kernel transport and authenticate enough to emit observation.
node publishes the functional constellation it belongs to.
node samples bounded service liveness declared for that host.
higher organs may dispatch bounded actions to this node through declared contracts.

forbidden_assumptions: glibc version matches the build machine
the node can build Rust locally
the node has a Dog backend
the lifecycle mempool is writable before storage bootstrap is healthy
the operator's local LAN is the universal service plane

heterogeneous_setup_policy.build_artifact: prefer static musl for Linux targets
heterogeneous_setup_policy.runtime_identity: derive OS and architecture at observation time
heterogeneous_setup_policy.activation: progress through bootstrap stages; never skip directly to deploy
heterogeneous_setup_policy.fallback: emergency direct mutation is allowed only to restore the bus, then must be assimilated into source contracts
